findings.method: SQL aggregation grouped by month for March and April 2025
findings.code:
SELECT 
    CASE 
        WHEN date >= '2025-03-01' AND date < '2025-04-01' THEN 'March 2025'
        WHEN date >= '2025-04-01' AND date < '2025-05-01' THEN 'April 2025'
    END as month,
    SUM(revenue) as total_revenue
FROM monthly_revenue
WHERE date >= '2025-03-01' AND date < '2025-05-01'
GROUP BY 
    CASE 
        WHEN date >= '2025-03-01' AND date < '2025-04-01' THEN 'March 2025'
        WHEN date >= '2025-04-01' AND date < '2025-05-01' THEN 'April 2025'
    END
ORDER BY month
